title: Derived diagonal forces cotangent vanishing
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings. If the canonical multiplication morphism $B\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B\to B[0]$ is an isomorphism in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], then the standard cotangent complex $L_{B/A}$ of [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence] is zero in $D(B)$.
